info.about: Bomberman Quest is an action role-playing game. The player takes the role of Bomberman, who has to defeat monsters and collect items to defeat the Commander bosses of each area.
info.trivia: Hudson Soft released it in Japan in December 1998, but the North American edition came from the small publisher Electro Brain in November 1999.
info.why: Japanese Hudson copies are plentiful and cheap, while the Electro Brain US release asks several times as much, so buyers check the region first.
